title: Odekake Kozame Anime Gets 2nd Film
content:
The second episode of the online radio program SameRadi! announced on Sunday that the anime of Penguin Box 's Odekake Kozame (Little Shark's Outings) manga will have a second film. The staff presented a teaser trailer and a teaser visual for Eiga Odekake Kozame Mizu no Machi no Omoide (Little Shark's Outings the Movie: Memories of the Water Town):

Director Chihiro Kumano and character designer Ayumi Takeuchi are returning from the project's first film and second net anime season, and scriptwriter Hiroaki Nagashima and the ENGI animation studio are also returning from all previous anime titles in the franchise . Three cast members — Kana Hanazawa (Kozame-chan), Megumi Han (Anko-chan), and Misaki Kuno (Usame-chan) — gave messages to celebrate the announcement of the new film.

The manga and its anime adaptations follow the nostalgic everyday adventures of a young shark.

Penguin Box debuted the manga on X (formerly Twitter ) in June 2021. The manga's eighth compiled book volume shipped in Japan on March 16.

The manga's first anime adaptation premiered on YouTube in August 2023, and its 60th and final episode streamed in May 2024. The anime also aired on television.

The first film, Eiga Odekake Kozame Tokai no Otomodachi opened in Japan in August 2025. The film centers on the titular character Kozame-chan's trip to the city, when she sees a glittering poster of the city in front of the Yaocho's train station. Dazed by a shark-shaped cloud, Kozame-chan boards the train and heads to the bright, noisy, crowded city, and starts a big adventure.

The second, ongoing season premiered on April 12 on TV Tokyo and its affiliates inside the Animori! program, which airs at 7:00 a.m. JST. The season also streams on YouTube starting on April 12 at 7:05 a.m. JST.
author: ANN

title: WEBTOON CEO Junkoo Kim Receives Outstanding Contribution Award at Korea's 26th Cartoon Day Ceremony
content:
WEBTOON Entertainment CEO Junkoo Kim received an outstanding contribution award for his contributions to the development of the webtoon industry at the 26th Cartoon Day ceremony, held on November 3 at the Korea Manhwa Museum in Bucheon, South Korea.

The Korea Manhwa Contents Agency announced the award recipients on November 5. Kim shared the award with attorney Sung-joo Kim of law firm Deoksu, who was recognized for his work protecting cartoonists' rights and providing legal support.

Twelve major industry organizations jointly organized the ceremony, including the Korea Cartoonists Association and the Cartoon and Webtoon Associations Federation. It recognized the cultural significance of Korean comics and acknowledged creators' work.

The event also included a talk concert on the present and future of print comics, with discussions covering independent publishing, production and distribution models, creator-led publishing, and support policies for diverse comics. Awards were also presented in three categories: the Korea Comics Critics Contest, the Korea Creative Comics Contest, and Today's Korean Comics .

Cartoon Day commemorates the November 3, 1996, rally at Seoul's Yeouido Plaza, where cartoonists gathered to oppose comics censorship and defend freedom of expression.

Korea Manhwa Contents Agency Chairman Kwan-je Cho said the global standing of Korean comics and webtoons reflects the dedication of earlier generations of cartoonists and the passion of current creators. He added that the agency would continue supporting the industry and its efforts to expand internationally.
author: ANN

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game Streams Story Trailer for 2nd Act 'Kure'
content:
Sega began streaming a story trailer for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century") on Friday. The video outlines the game's second act "Kure," and highlights the protagonist Makoto Daito's life in 1929 in Kure.

A previous trailer outlined the game's first act.

The game will explore different times and places in Japan's modern history, including Kokura, Fukuoka in 1915; Kure, Hiroshima in 1929; Minami, Osaka in 1943; Atami, Shizuoka in 1951; and the fictional neighborhood of Kamurocho (based on the Kabukicho neighborhood, and a constant setting of RGG Studio's Yakuza/Like a Dragon games) in Shinjuku, Tokyo in 1965.

Sega describes the game's story:

A 50-year saga of those with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. In 1915 San Francisco, a young boy, Makoto Daito, sneaks aboard a suspicious ship in the harbor under the cover of night. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto faces harsh persecution due to his Asian heritage. After losing both of his parents, Makoto decides to travel to his mother's homeland, Japan, where a fateful encounter awaits. With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life.

The cast includes:

• Yū Shirota as Makoto Daito

• Snoop Dogg as Orpheus

• Moeka Hoshi as Tae Matsumoto

• Tori Kelly as Suzy Day

• Akio Ōtsuka as Heigo Yashima

• Tokuma Nishioka as Kiyoshi Otsuru

• Satoshi Fujihara as Takashi

• Cordell Broadus as The Veiled Stranger

• Ado as Keiko Shirai

• Bunta Sugawara (model basis) and Takashi Ukaji (voice) as Genzo Iwaki

• Late American rapper Tupac

• Takaya Kuroda (who plays Kazuma Kiryu in Ryu ga Gotoku's related Yakuza/Like a Dragon series)

• Kouhei Tsuji

• Yasukaze Motomiya (who plays Kosei Shishido in the Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name game and Kazuma Kiryu in Nihon Tohitsu's live-action Like a Dragon Powered By Nihon Touitsu series)

Sega provided the following comment regarding the character Genzo Iwaki and the model for the character being based on the late actor Bunta Sugawara :

In STRANGER THAN HEAVEN , the late and legendary actor Bunta Sugawara appears. SEGA received formal consent from his family, and, with materials provided by Toei Company Ltd. —which produced many of Mr. Sugawara's films, including the Battles Without Honor and Humanity — RGG Studio crafted his CG character design based on archival footage and photographs from the time.

Snoop Dogg , Satoshi Fujihara , Ado, and Tori Kelly perform the game's theme song "Stranger Than Heaven." The song will get a release this year.

The game is inspiring a live-action film on Netflix .

Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties , Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's remake of the Yakuza 3 game along with the new standalone Dark Ties title, launched as a single release for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam worldwide on February 12.

title: MyGO and Ave Mujica Anime Sequel Unveils 2nd Trailer Featuring MyGO
content:
A second trailer was unveiled for the upcoming anime sequel to MyGO and Ave Mujica, titled BanG Dream! MyGO!!!!! // Ave Mujica . The latest trailer mainly features the MyGO and the anime is slated to premiere on January 8, 2027. An Ave Mujica focused video was previously released last month.

The voice cast will reprise their roles for the sequel:

• Hina Youmiya as Tomori Takamatsu

• Kanon Takao as Sakiko Togawa/Oblivionis

• Rin Tateishi as Anon Chihaya

• Mika Kohinata as Soyo Nagasaki

• Yuzuki Watase as Mutsumi Wakaba/Mortis

• Coco Hayashi as Taki Shina

• Rico Sasaki as Uika Misumi/Doloris

• Hina Aoki as Rana Kaname

• Akane Yonezawa as Nyamu Yutenji/Amoris

• Mei Okada as Umiri Yahata/Timoris

• Hazuki Tanda as Mana Sumita

Muse Asia is streaming both BanG Dream! It’s MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast . They describe the former as follows: “Would you play in a band for your whole life?” Late spring of the first year of high school. Everyone at Haneoka Girls’ High School is in a band. Anon, who enrolled in school late, rushes to find band members so she can fit in with her classmates as soon as possible. While at it, she learned that Tomori, the “Haneoka’s Weirdo Girl”, has not yet formed a band. And then, Anon calls on her… The scream of our music may be covered in scars and ill-formed. Even if we get lost, just move forward.

title: RetroCrush Streams Sugar Sugar Rune, Genocyber Anime
content:
The service has also now added many of the titles it had announced in August that it was adding from Viz Media , including: Vampire Knight , Accel World , Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow , Sailor Moon R: The Movie , Bleach the Movie: Hell Verse , and Captain Tsubasa . The service will add Hunter × Hunter: Phantom Rouge on November 20 and Hikaru no Go on November 27.

RetroCrush had added Vampire Princess Miyu with a Japanese dub on October 2 and with an English dub on October 30.

Discotek Media released Genocyber on Blu-ray Disc in January 2021. The anime is based on Tony Takezaki 's manga.

The Sugar Sugar Rune anime debuted in July 2005 and the Tubi service began streaming the series in January of this year. The anime is based on Moyoco Anno 's manga that was serialized in Kodansha 's Nakayoshi magazine from 2004 to 2007.

Cult Epics most recently released The Girl Who Leapt Through Time on Blu-ray Disc on January 20 earlier this year. Nobuhiko Ōbayashi directed the film with a script by Wataru Kenmotsu . The movie is based on the same novel by Yasutaka Tsutsui that inspired Mamoru Hosoda 's 2006 anime film.

title: Bride of the Barrier Master Anime Streams Video for Hana's Twin Hazuki Ichise
content:
The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's Bride of the Barrier Master ( Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ) light novel series started streaming the character promotional video for Hana's twin sister Hazuki Ichise (as voiced by Kanon Takao ) on Sunday.

Yen Press ' Yen On imprint publishes the light novels in English and describes the story:

For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. But that ideal lifestyle begins to slip out of reach when Saku Ichinomiya takes over as the new head of the Ichinomiya clan and sets out to find a bride strong enough to stand by his side. Eager to keep her abilities secret, Hana steers clear of Saku... but will she be tempted to sign a marriage contract if it guarantees the peaceful, quiet future of her dreams?

The anime will star:

• Akari Kitō as Hana Ichise

• Kikunosuke Toya as Saku Ichinomiya

• Kanon Takao as Hazuki Ichise

• Hiroto Shimizu as Nozomi Ichinomiya

• Yuzuki Tamukai as Azuha

• Taihi Kimura as Aoi

• M.A.O as Miyabi

Tōru Kitahata ( Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It , Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf! , Hinako Note ) is directing the anime at TROYCA . Minami Murayama ( ATRI: My Dear Moments six episodes, IDOLiSH7 Third Beat! three episodes animation director) is designing the characters, and Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , Cells at Work! , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yukari Hashimoto ( Mr. Osomatsu , Penguindrum ), Ruka Kawada ( Is the order a rabbit? , Isekai Quartet ), and R.O.N ( Kusunoki's Garden of Gods , FLCL Alternative ) are composing the music.

The anime will premiere in January 2027. The anime will stream on Netflix and on other streaming platforms.

Kadokawa published the novels' first volume with Bodax 's illustrations in December 2021, and it published the seventh volume on June 16. The novels have over 2.5 million copies in circulation.

Odayaka 's manga adaptation launched on Kadokawa 's B's-LOG COMIC digital manga magazine in March 2022. Kadokawa will publish the manga's ninth compiled book volume on December 28. Yen Press also publishes the manga adaptation in English.

title: MAGES Develops Girls und Panzer Mahjong Game For PS5, Switch 2
content:
MAGES revealed the title, release window, and teaser video on Saturday for the "new consumer game " it is developing for the Girls und Panzer franchise. The "tag strike mahjong" game is titled Girls & Panzer Hakunetsu! Mahjong Tag Battle Desu! (Girls & Panzer Heating Up! It's a Mahjong Tag Battle!), and it is slated for a release in 2027 on the Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5.

The game will feature more than 30 characters, and will also have both a story mode and an online battle mode. MAGES does not list the game's supported languages on its website.

The Girls und Panzer franchise had also announced two separate games in October.

D3Publisher is developing the Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival game, which will launch for the Switch 2 in Japan in 2027. The same team that handled the Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match PlayStation 4 game is also working on the new game. The game will focus on controllable tank battles, but will also allow players to control Miho and walk around a recreation of the story's Ōarai town (itself based on the real-life town of Ōarai).

G Holdings is developing the Girls und Panzer : Bokosuka Rush smartphone game. G Holdings describes the game as being set in the "Boko Museum" that appears in the Girls und Panzer der Film anime. In the game, Miho and Alice visit the museum and try out the "tank simulator" there, only to be confronted with Boko as their enemy. The game will allow players to mix up crew and the tanks they operate, with crew getting progressively better, and unlocking more abilities for tanks. The game currently does not have a release window.

Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match launched for the PS4 in Japan and Southeast Asia (with English text support) in February 2018. The Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match DX Switch version shipped in Japan and Southeast Asia (with English text support) in February 2019.

The latest anime in the franchise, the fifth film of Girls und Panzer das Finale , opened in Japan on October 9.

title: Even the Student Council Has It's Holes! Anime Casts Yōko Hikasa
content:
The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga confirmed on Sunday that Yōko Hikasa plays Masaki Kotobuki, Hisako Kotobuki's mother who appeared in episode 7 this weekend.

The staff also began streaming the anime's new opening sequence:

Seven Seas publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life manga that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

The series stars:

• Shōgo Sakata as Mizunoe Ume

• Haruka Shiraishi as Hisako Kotobuki

• Miyu Tomita as Komaro Michinoku

• Hiyori Kōno as Tan Otori

• Shizuka Ishigami as Arisu Terui

• Yumi Uchiyama as Satomi Hiratsuka

Naoyuki Tatsuwa ( Ōmuro-ke , Gourmet Girl Graffiti , Nisekoi - False Love , Promise of Wizard ) is directing the anime at Passione , Ryo Imamura ( ONIMAI: I'm Now Your Sister! ) is designing the characters and is the chief animation director, and Masahiro Yokotani ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! , Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- , Beelzebub , The Devil Is a Part-Timer! ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts.

Other staff members include:

• Main Animators: Kay Yu, Kona Ming (name romanization not confirmed), Asatoshi Oki, mockingbird, SanzashiAme, and Mushiki (name romanization not confirmed)

• Art Director: Hiromichi Itō

• Color Design: Arisa Komatsu

• Director of Photography: Junpei Takatsu

• Editing: Michi Takigawa

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Music: Tomoki Kikuya

Sangatsu no Phantasia performs the opening theme song "Kaze no Naka wa Hashirukkya Inai."

The anime premiered on October 3 and runs on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV . The d Anime Store and AnimeFesta services stream the anime both in its "on air" version and its "unrestricted" version in Japan. OceanVeil also streams simultaneously the anime with English subtitles in both versions, along with an English dub .

Muchimaro launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in 2022. Kodansha shipped the 13th compiled book volume on August 17. Seven Seas shipped the first volume on September 8. K MANGA also publishes the series in English digitally.

The manga received an animated ad in July 2024. The manga won in the print category of the ninth Next Manga Awards (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2023.

contentBlocks.text: Seven Seas publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life manga that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

Miyu Tomita as Komaro Michinoku
Hiyori Kōno as Tan Otori

title: 5 Most Powerful Dragon Ball Super Characters Goku Can’t Defeat
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Dragon Ball Super manga! Dragon Ball Super was released as a sequel to the main story, and it expanded the world-building by introducing the parallel universes. As the world became larger, more characters were introduced, each with their own set of powers and abilities. Two decades after concluding the original manga, Akira Toriyama returned with the Dragon Ball Super series, with Toyotaro working as the illustrator. The story takes place a few years after the defeat of Buu, where Goku and his friends are living peaceful lives with their families. While nothing significant has happened over the years, Goku and Vegeta refuse to give up on training and testing the limits of their powers as Super Saiyans.

However, just when things seemed calm, the God of Destruction named Beerus , known to be the most powerful deity in the universe, awakened from his slumber. Not long after awakening, he began searching for a legendary Super Saiyan God he saw in a prophetic dream. Since Beerus’ thrilling fight with Goku, the manga has featured one adventure after another as Goku and the Z Fighters continue to become more powerful. Over the years, Goku has reached new heights of power that he never thought were possible. Even so, he still can’t defeat these five extraordinarily powerful characters.

5) Beerus

Beerus was the first opponent of Goku introduced in Dragon Ball Super , and even now, hardly any characters can beat him. While initially an antagonist of the Battle of Gods Arc, it didn’t take long for him to join Goku’s side since what he needed was a worthy rival. During the Battle of Gods Arc, Goku borrowed the powers of his fellow Saiyans and awakened a legendary form called the Super Saiyan God. However, even after Goku used up all of his newfound powers, Beerus still only had to use a fraction of his powers to easily defeat him.

Goku has grown considerably more powerful ever since he met Beerus, but defeating a God of Destruction is something unheard of. Beerus is literally the embodiment of destruction thanks to his divine powers paired with eons of experience, making it virtually impossible for any mortal to overpower him.

4) Whis

Although Whis was initially believed to be Beerus’ attendant , it turns out he’s an Angel and the martial arts teacher of the God of Destruction. Angels exist to guide and supervise the Gods of Destruction, placing them on a completely different tier of power even among the immortal beings. Whis is the one who taught Goku to tap into the power of Ultra Instinct that only Angels have been able to use for eons, considering that it requires the user to be in a state of mind and self-movement where the body reacts autonomously to danger without requiring conscious thought from the brain.

Angels like Whis are always in a state of Ultra Instinct, as evidenced by their white hair. Not only that, but Ultra Instinct is so difficult to master that even Beerus can only use it imperfectly. On top of his extraordinary godly abilities that canonically make him more powerful than Beerus, Whis has the ability to turn three minutes into the past and easily travel between universes with a speed that no one can match.

3) Black Frieza

Frieza is one enemy Goku hasn’t been able to get rid of no matter how many times they fight. Starting from the Namek Saga, the villain keeps returning with new powers even after his death. Whether his army revived him or if Goku needed his help, regardless of the situation, the villain remains a crucial part of Dragon Ball Super since the beginning. After the Tournament of Power between all universes was over, he came back to life and dedicated himself to training again.

He returned at the end of the Granolah the Survivor Saga and showed off his new form, which he named Black Frieza. Unlike Golden Frieza, this new form is unimaginably more powerful and better in terms of speed and durability. He managed to defeat Goku in his Ultra Instinct state and Ultra Ego Vegeta together in one blow. The impact of the attack forced them both out of their transformations, displaying the difference in their skills.

2) Fused Zamasu

Out of all the villains in Dragon Ball Super , Zamasu gave Goku and the others the most difficulty. He altered timelines, stole Goku’s body, ruined the world of Future Trunks, and even made himself undefeatable. As a Kai, he was already immortal with an endless lifespan, but that doesn’t mean he couldn’t be killed. This is why he used the Super Dragon Balls to make himself an absolute immortal and teamed up with his future self to destroy all mortals from the universe. Fused Zamasu especially was the most powerful form he had since it’s a fusion of Black Goku and his future self.

With the abilities of a Saiyan and the immortality of a God, Fused Zamasu possessed the level of power that even Beerus couldn’t overcome. Although in terms of raw power, Beerus would stand on top, even he couldn’t do anything to stop him. Goku had no choice but to use Omni-King Zeno’s help to erase the timeline and Zamasu with it.

1) Grand Zeno

While he may look like a mascot character, Grand Zeno, the Omni-King, is the most feared being by everyone in all universes. This goes for even the Gods of Destruction, who are always careful in his presence. Zeno may not be a fighter, but he is the most powerful being in all Universes as someone who holds absolute authority and the power to erase entire timelines in an instant. This divine being doesn’t possess any martial arts ability, so he is unable to track the high-speed movements of fighters.

However, he doesn’t need to fight anyone in order to destroy them. Just one thought of Zeno can erase Goku’s existence along with his universe, which is why it worked out best for the Saiyan to befriend this godly being instead of making an enemy out of him. Without Zeno’s interference, there was no way for anyone to stop Zamasu’s rampage.

Which of these Dragon Ball Super characters do you think poses the biggest challenge for Goku, and is there anyone else he cannot defeat at his current level? Share your picks in the comments below!

title: How Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Finally Dethroned Fullmetal Alchemist
content:
Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is sitting at the top spot of MyAnimeList , a position that has been held almost exclusively by Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood for years . Even without sites like MyAnimeList for tracking popularity, there is a consensus among many anime fans that Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood sits at the top or at least very high among anime series. Since its inception the anime has set a high bar for shows that follow it, and very few have even come close.

With Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End now sitting at the top spot , what allowed it to finally surpass the anime that sat at the top for so long? Additionally, what factors made Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood so compelling in the first place? The anime’s story and world are compelling, but that alone isn’t enough to allow it to hold the top spot for so long.

Both Frieren & Fullmetal Alchemist Remain Consistent With Their Rules

A big draw of Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood is the way its alchemy system works. Alchemy is so powerful in the universe that on the surface it can be mistaken for magic. The system itself, however, is quickly laid out for us with its own set of rules that make sense. Although the anime introduces characters who are incredibly skilled with alchemy, the fundamentals remain the same. There are plenty of examples of this same concept being applied in Frieren .

Visualization is a big part of magic in the Frieren universe , and as a result, people who can visualize well or have strong imaginations make for powerful mages. Demons are known to be arrogant and this is almost always how the human characters defeat them. This may seem like a no-brainer characteristic for an anime to have, but popular series like Dragon Ball are even guilty of having inconsistent rules. This isn’t a make or break factor for fans, obviously, but it is often seen as lazy or bad writing if the rules of a universe are inconsistent.

Neither Frieren Nor Fullmetal Alchemist Rely on Tropes

Another standout characteristic of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is how it doesn’t rely on tropes that have become commonplace in the anime industry. Things like fanservice and problematic character archetypes can be found in the majority of mainstream anime, but Frieren doesn’t have either of these. The same can be said about Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood . For example, corrupt or taboo behaviors is something we see male characters fall into quite frequently in anime. While this normally takes the form of something like having an unhealthy infatuation with their sister or underage girls, Frieren simply has its characters be corrupt in ways that make sense or are more understandable.

Heiter drinks and Sein gambles, two undoubtedly harmful behaviors. But they’re ones that never drag the narrative or characters down to make the fans unnecessarily uncomfortable. This is not to say that an anime series can’t succeed while also having these tropes. We have seen this plenty of times as many of the big shonen action titles have characters that fall into these perverted archetypes, but these anime succeed in spite of this not because of it.

Anime like Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood and Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End are shining examples of what happens when you don’t reinvent the wheel. Within these two you have what already makes many top rated anime so popular (stories, characters, animation) only without the things (perverted characters and other tropes) that could alienate certain audiences.

Frieren & Fullmetal Alchemist Gut You in Unexpected Ways

The plot of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is hard to bring into conversation with something like Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood because of how different they are. There is no grand conflict to resolve in the main story since the plot of Frieren is that the grand conflict has already happened. The anime has intense action sequences, but it’s not always the main focus. Instead it opts to create emotional moments in less flashy ways . We see Frieren struggle with very human things like regret and the limited lifespans of the people she cares about. It is a sort of emotion that isn’t quite as in your face or traumatic as what the Elric brothers went through but it still hits hard.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End and Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood deliver powerful narratives while stripping away things that could take away or distract from the narrative. They have earned their top spots by combining action with emotional beats and remaining consistently good throughout. Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End sits above Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood now not because it is necessarily better, but because it is just as good. It isn’t every day that fans find an anime they feel is worthy of the crown.

Do you still think Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood should hold the top spot over Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End ? What other shows compete with it? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.
